elements.name: Early morning open bus station yard with soft gold light and long shadows
Single-file queue of men and women seen from behind
Queue running in a long curve across the yard
Queue leading to a small ticket window in a low building
Young man with backpack as last in queue, nearest, seen from behind
Long-distance buses parked along one side

anatomy: The young man's feet look reversed: the sandal toes seem to point toward the viewer while his body faces away.
notes: Repaint the young man's feet so the heels face the viewer. Bend the queue into a long curve that ends at a visible ticket window in the low building, rather than running straight toward the buses on the left.
